pages.text:
File 6
Listening 1
Neil
What did you do at the weekend, Rachel?
Rachel Oh, I went to the cinema with Matt, my boyfriend.
Neil
Oh right. What did you see?
Rachel Er … oh, I can’t remember. It was a film Matt wanted to
see. He told me it was good so I went with him. Erm …
I think it was End of the Night.
Neil
End of the Night? I don’t know it. Are you sure that was the
name?
Rachel Well …
Neil
Or was it End of the Day?
Rachel Yes. That’s it. Sorry. I’m terrible with names.
Neil
That’s OK. What did you think of it? Did you like it?
Rachel No. It was awful. Matt really liked it, of course. But I
didn’t. The actors were good but the story was terrible.
Neil
Who was in it?
Rachel Oh … er … Julia Knight was in it. She played a beautiful
lawyer called Mary. And Jack Pitt. He played a young
doctor called Tom. In the film, Tom loved Mary, but she
didn’t love him.
Neil
OK. I really don’t like romantic films. I’m glad I didn’t see
it.
File 6
Listening 2
1
John
What did you think of the play, Sarah?
Sarah
Oh, I thought it was great.
John
Really?
Sarah
Yes. Why? Didn’t you, John?
John
Well, no, to be honest. I really didn’t like it at all.
2
Petra
Are there any pictures in your bedroom, Jack?
Jack
Sure. There’s a picture near my desk, and there are two
other pictures on the wall near the door.
Petra
What are the pictures of?
Jack
Well, there’s one of a train, one of a beautiful view of the
mountains, and the picture near the desk is a photo I
took when I was on holiday.
3
Peter
Do you live in a village, Jenny?
Jenny
Yes.
Peter
Are there any bars or restaurants in the village?
Jenny
Well, there’s a bar. And there was a really good Chinese
restaurant, but it closed two years ago.
Peter
Oh, what a pity.
4
Sandra
Where’s Tom?
Patrick I don’t know, Sandra. Did you call him?
Sandra
Well, I called his house in the afternoon. But he wasn’t in.
I spoke to his sister but I didn’t speak to him.
Patrick Oh dear. Perhaps he doesn’t know what time we wanted
to meet.
5
Simon
Where did you stay?
Donna
At the Hotel Central.
Simon
Was it good?
Donna
Well, no, not really. The room was small and cold, and
well, there was a telephone in the room but there wasn’t a
television.
